# ===================================================================== # Employee archived -> disconnect their GoodCard contacts. # Automation 9 (hr.employee, on archive) / action 1731. # Finds contacts by the employee's work contact (even if already # archived, so its pricelist is still reset) AND by work email. # Runs for every archived employee, whatever their email domain; # resets the public pricelist in every company, archives what Odoo # allows, and writes in the chatter exactly what was done. # =====================================================================
# ---- Constants ------------------------------------------------------- AUTHOR_USER_ID = 148 # HR Spain, author of the notes COMPANY_PRICELIST_MAP = {1: 1, 7: 13, 8: 58, 12: 654} # company -> public pricelist (12 = GN UK, added 23/11/2026) NOTE_SUBTYPE = 'mail.mt_note'
# sudo: the HR user archiving may not have access to every company Partner = env['res.partner'].sudo() Users = env['res.users'].sudo() author_id = Users.browse(AUTHOR_USER_ID).partner_id.id
for employee in records.sudo(): if employee.active: continue
# 1) Candidate contacts: the work contact (active or not) + every active contact with the same email contacts = employee.work_contact_id if employee.work_email: contacts |= Partner.search([('email_normalized', '=', employee.work_email.strip().lower())])
if not contacts: employee.message_post( body='%s: no contact found (no work contact and no contact with the work email), Good Card NOT disconnected. Check it manually.' % employee.name, author_id=author_id, subtype_xmlid=NOTE_SUBTYPE, ) continue
# 2) Odoo refuses to archive the contact of an active user: leave those active and say so blocked = Users.search([('partner_id', 'in', contacts.ids)]).partner_id to_archive = (contacts - blocked).filtered('active')
# 3) Public pricelist in every mapped company (company-dependent property) for company_id, pricelist_id in COMPANY_PRICELIST_MAP.items(): for contact in contacts.with_company(company_id): if contact.property_product_pricelist.id != pricelist_id: contact.write({'property_product_pricelist': pricelist_id})
if to_archive: to_archive.write({'active': False})
# 4) Chatter: exactly what happened summary = '%s Good Card has been disconnected. Public pricelist set on: %s.' % ( employee.name, ', '.join(contacts.mapped('display_name'))) if to_archive: summary += ' Archived: %s.' % ', '.join(to_archive.mapped('display_name')) if blocked: summary += ' NOT archived, linked to an active user (archive the user first): %s.' % ', '.join(blocked.mapped('display_name'))
employee.message_post(body=summary, author_id=author_id, subtype_xmlid=NOTE_SUBTYPE) for contact in contacts: contact.message_post(body=summary, author_id=author_id, subtype_xmlid=NOTE_SUBTYPE)

# =========================================================================== # ACCIÓN PLANIFICADA — Loyalty Program 48 (Producción) # Procesa hasta 30 loyalty.card con points > 0 ejecutando Server Action 1816 # ===========================================================================
BATCH_SIZE = 30 LOYALTY_PROGRAM_ID = 48 SERVER_ACTION_ID = 1759
# 1. Validar que la Server Action existe server_action = env['ir.actions.server'].browse(SERVER_ACTION_ID).exists()
if not server_action: log("Server Action %s no existe. Abortando." % SERVER_ACTION_ID, level='error') else: # 2. Lote de pendientes (points > 0 excluye saldos a 0) records = env['loyalty.card'].search( [ ('program_id', '=', LOYALTY_PROGRAM_ID), ('points', '>', 0), ], limit=BATCH_SIZE, order='id asc', )
if not records: log("Sin pendientes en program %s con points > 0" % LOYALTY_PROGRAM_ID, level='info') else: processed = 0 errors = 0
for record in records: try: server_action.with_context( active_model='loyalty.card', active_id=record.id, active_ids=[record.id], ).run() processed += 1 except Exception as e: errors += 1 log( "Error loyalty.card %s (points=%s): %s" % (record.id, record.points, e), level='error', )
# 3. Resumen final log( "Lote completado | program=%s | procesados=%s | errores=%s | total=%s" % ( LOYALTY_PROGRAM_ID, processed, errors, len(records) ), level='info', )
